cases.title: Natural trips (6 seeds): 776 samples, 11 sensors AVAILABLE and physically plausible, 0 rule events, 200 ms axis
cases.input: SimulationSource NORMAL default length through Session + SQLite

cases.title: Every sensor changes over the trip (stored readings come from the simulator, not constants)
cases.input: count distinct stored values per sensor over 776 samples
cases.expected: >= 5 distinct values for every sensor except possibly trims

cases.title: Long simulation (600 s and 900 s) keeps driving: no engine stop, continuous time axis, no false events
cases.expected: 3001/4501 samples, RPM > 500 after 45 s, speed still varies after 150 s, 0 events

cases.title: Default 155 s trip unchanged by the long-run fix (776 samples ending at 155.0 s)
Seven single faults (60 s, 35 s) each raise their own rule event
cases.actual: S01->['MS_THERMAL']; S02->['MS_AIR_FUEL']; S03->['MS_FUEL_RESPONSE']; S04->['MS_AIRFLOW']; S05->['MS_SUPPLY']; S06->['MS_COMBUSTION']; S07->['MS_SIGNAL']

cases.title: Simultaneous faults keep every event (S04+S07 included)
cases.input: six pairs injected at 60 s for 35 s
cases.expected: both expected kinds for every injectable pair (masking fixed); non-injectable pairs reported
cases.actual: {"S04+S07": ["MS_AIRFLOW", "MS_SIGNAL"], "S01+S05": ["MS_SUPPLY", "MS_THERMAL"], "S02+S06": "not injectable: Conflicting scenario writes: S02, S06", "S03+S05": "not injectable: Conflicting scenario writes: S03, S05", "S01+S07": ["MS_SIGNAL", "MS_THERMAL"], "S02+S07": "not injectable: Conflicting scenario writes: S02, S07"}
cases.notes: Pairs rejected by the simulator are not counted as failures; they conflict on the sensors they write (documented in DC-FIX-001).

cases.title: Random multisensor faults (12 seeds): runs finish, events complete, no crash
cases.expected: no exception; event COMPLETE if T+30 s fits in the 155 s trip, otherwise PARTIAL (trip ended)

cases.title: A second fault of the same kind whose trigger lands exactly at T+30 is recorded, not swallowed
cases.input: S02 at 60 s (9 s) and S02 at 90 s (9 s): the second trigger is the first + 30.0 s
cases.expected: two MS_AIR_FUEL events 30.0 s apart, both COMPLETE
cases.actual: first-run triggers=[66000]; two-fault triggers=[66000, 96000]; gap=30000; statuses=['COMPLETE', 'COMPLETE']

cases.title: Event window holds T-30..T+30, saved to SQLite, restored identically by a new connection; export verifies as Replay
cases.input: S01 at 60 s -> events -> reopen DB -> export -> ReplaySource.verify
cases.expected: pre/post coverage, ordered, restored == saved, export 776 samples
cases.actual: [{"kind": "MS_THERMAL", "T_s": 68.2, "first_s": 38.2, "last_s": 98.2, "n": 301, "status": "COMPLETE", "pre_ok": true, "post_ok": true, "ordered": true}]; restored_identical=True; replay_verify={'ok': True, 'stages': ['FILE_VALID', 'SAMPLE_VALID'], 'samples': 776}

cases.title: Replay with finite implausible values (RPM=1e308/-5000/9999999, 500 C, MAF 1e9, 5000 kPa): never AVAILABLE, session survives
cases.input: mutate 6 samples of an exported session and replay it through Session
cases.expected: each injected reading stored with a non-AVAILABLE quality

cases.title: Replay containing NaN / Infinity / -Infinity as a reading value is rejected with a clear error, not stored
cases.actual: {"NaN": "rejected: ValueError: reading must be a finite number or null", "Infinity": "rejected: ValueError: reading must be a finite number or null", "-Infinity": "rejected: ValueError: reading must be a finite number or null"}

cases.title: App policy (ml_alerts=False): ML never opens an event; rule events identical with/without ML; ML hits are only advisory
cases.input: same trips with analyzer None / ml_alerts False / ml_alerts True
cases.expected: rules_only == app policy; no ML_ANOMALY event in app policy
cases.notes: tuple = (rule events, app-policy events, ml_alerts=True events, advisory ML hits)

cases.title: Explains the miss in QA-E2E-005b: a 5 s S07 fault at 90 s falls inside the still-open MS_SIGNAL window (68.0 s + 30 s) and is merged; its invalid readings still raise DATA_QUALITY
cases.input: S07 flatline 60 s/18 s + S07 implausible 90 s/5 s
cases.expected: one MS_SIGNAL event whose window covers 90 s, plus a DATA_QUALITY event at ~90 s (documented same-kind merge, REMAINING_RISKS #9)
cases.notes: By design since DC-FIX-001 (one event per kind while its window is open); a second fault of the same kind within 30 s is not given its own event.

cases.title: All temp databases pass integrity_check/foreign_key_check and have user_version=2
